title: PixelSight
description: PixelSight is a professional in-game editor for Minecraft 1.20.1 that allows you to draw your own 16x16 pixel crosshair with full RGB color support. By pressing the "Period" key, you can instantly replace the vanilla aiming reticle with your unique cus
body:
PixelSight is a lightweight and powerful utility mod for Minecraft 1.20.1 that gives you total control over your aiming experience. Forget about boring standard crosshairs — now you can draw your own pixel by pixel!

Key Features:

In-Game Editor: No need to mess with texture packs or restart the game. Press "Period" (Ю) to open the 16x16 drawing grid.

RGB Color Picker: Use the built-in color controls to create a crosshair in any color you want. Want it neon pink? Or classic lime green? It's up to you!

Clean Experience: The mod automatically hides the vanilla Minecraft crosshair, ensuring your custom creation is the only thing on your screen.

Real-Time Updates: Your changes are applied instantly the moment you close the editor.

How to use:

Enter your world.

Press the "> ." key on your keyboard.

Click on the pixels to draw your shape and use the RGB labels to adjust the color.

Press ESC to save and dominate!
